title: Blind Spot
subtitle: AI inspection oversight
project.name: Riverside House renovation
project.desc: Pre-release validation · north façade drone survey
role.label: Your role
role.name: Senior AI Inspection Reviewer
intro.title: The AI finished first. Your inspection has not.
intro.body: Automated analysis has produced a preliminary façade map containing flagged findings and apparently clear areas. Validate its conclusions before they enter the renovation report.
intro.objective: Compare the original imagery with the AI evidence. Validate supported output, flag questionable output, and scrutinise apparently clean areas where something may have been missed.
intro.principle: AI confidence indicates how certain the model is about its own output. It does not guarantee that the output is correct.
tool.rawHelp: Original drone imagery without AI markup.
tool.aiHelp: The area identified by the automated system.
tool.contextHelp: Surface and image-quality information for interpretation.
tool.focusHelp: Image areas that most influenced the AI output.
tool.overlayHelp: Fade the visualisation against the original image.
help.title: AI Review Reference
help.confidenceBody: The model's certainty in its own prediction. High confidence can still accompany an incorrect result.
help.fpBody: The AI reports a finding that human validation does not support.
help.fnBody: A real issue is present but the AI does not detect it.
help.qualityBody: Image conditions can affect how useful automated output is.
help.generalisationBody: Performance may change when the system encounters a different context.
help.focusBody: Shows which visual areas influenced the output; attention on a nearby feature can be misleading.
help.humanBody: Professional review determines what can enter the inspection and what needs further attention.
board.label: Building-wide AI inspection
board.title: North elevation · flight 27
board.help: Select detections and AI-clear areas directly on the façade.
board.markConcern: Mark dark textured area as AI Reliability Concern
panel.emptyBody: Reviewing only cyan detections leaves the AI's clean conclusions untested. Select any architectural area to investigate.
guide.first: Start with the Raw Image, then compare the AI Mask.
guide.fade: Fade the overlay to see whether the highlighted area matches the visible evidence.
guide.decide: Confidence is useful, but inspect the evidence before deciding.
guide.second: This sample is independent. Use Context or Focus Map if the raw image and AI output do not agree.
guide.soft: Several reviewed samples share contextual information. Compare where the AI has performed well and poorly.
feedback.tpValidated: The visible feature and AI mask align, and the Focus Map is concentrated on the same evidence. This finding can remain in the inspection.
feedback.tpOverFlagged: The visible feature, mask and Focus Map support one another. Flagging it withholds a supported finding for additional work.
feedback.fpFlagged: The AI reported high confidence, but its mask and Focus Map follow the adjacent cladding joint. Human review withholds the unsupported finding.
feedback.fpPassed: The mask follows a cladding joint rather than supported surface evidence. High confidence did not make this output reliable, so validating it leaves a misleading finding in the report.
feedback.fnFound: The raw image contains visible evidence in an AI-clear area, while the Focus Map is concentrated elsewhere. Human review adds a potential missed finding.
feedback.fnMissed: The raw image contains visible evidence that the AI-clear result omitted. Confirming the clean result leaves the potential finding absent from the report.
feedback.tnConfirmed: The raw image and nearby reference support the AI-clear result. Human validation confirms that no finding needs to be added.
feedback.tnOverFlagged: The raw image and nearby reference support the clear result. Flagging it sends supported output for unnecessary additional review.
pattern.one: One reviewed mismatch appears in the dark textured context. More evidence is needed before treating it as systematic.
pattern.ready: Multiple reviewed errors now share the dark textured context. You can mark that area as an AI Reliability Concern.
pattern.marked: The dark textured area is withheld as a broader reliability concern. Unreviewed output there now requires human attention.
audit.minimum: Record at least five sample decisions before release review.
audit.remaining: You can still use {count} review actions.
report.strongBody: Human decisions corrected unreliable output and contained the affected context before information entered the renovation report.
report.weakTitle: Inspection still contains unresolved AI risk.
report.weakBody: The chosen decisions leave misleading or missing information in the preliminary report. Continue the audit or route the affected context for human review.
report.oneSided: Sampling covered only one output type
footer.note: Confidence and review capacity are scenario values for this gameplay prototype, not universal thresholds.
